name: Camp Farmington Valley
operator_name: YMCA of Greater Hartford (Farmington Valley YMCA)
description_short: A state-licensed YMCA day camp in Granby, CT, for children entering kindergarten through 8th grade. Each week has a theme, and activities include swim lessons, archery, a climbing wall, arts and crafts, nature and field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Deposits are nonrefundable and can only be transferred within the current camp year. No refunds for cancellations made within 4 weeks of a session's start. If you ask in writing, paid fees can be moved to another week if there is space. The remaining balance is drafted 4 weeks before each session.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has an indoor pool. The program includes free swim and swim instruction.

warnings: The only dates shown are for summer 2026, which has already ended. The page says '2027 Pricing and Registration Coming Soon.'

The page gives no weekly price for summer day camp. The only prices listed are for Y Vacation Days (grades K-5): $85/day for members and $115/day for program participants. Those are separate from summer camp.
The page contradicts itself on camper-to-counselor ratios: 1:6 and 1:10 in one place, 1:9 and 1:12 in the FAQ.
The page contradicts itself on how long a physical exam is valid: 1 year in one place, 3 years in the FAQ.
The page contradicts itself on when to drop off medication: one week before each session in one place, the first day of each session in another.
